purpose: Prioritize remaining active/provisional heuristics after the completed hard-code audit without reopening that audit.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Keep legacy owner-specific and football-market percentage multipliers diagnostic-only; use market anchors, canonical projections/Simulator, continuous utility and BI in their appropriate roles.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Use Shared Decision Utility 2.0 with league-relative Simulator normalization and observed market-value scales; no fixed cross-unit conversion coefficients.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Preserve full owned asset pool and all plausibility bands; heuristics prioritize simulation work but cannot erase a candidate solely by band.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Use the same Shared Decision Utility 2.0 as Trade Decision; legacy categorical state weights and contender/dynasty guardrails are diagnostic-only.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Keep pair-insurance/context diagnostics, but disable incremental final-score and acceptance value because replacement resilience is already modeled.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Use adaptive league-sample shrinkage and confidence-weighted BI2/BI3 integration instead of fixed blend/adjustment coefficients.
improve_now_with_existing_evidence.remaining_gap: Time-ordered held-out manager-choice evidence is still required for empirical promotion/calibrated probability.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Retain continuous Simulator-indexed objective curve as an explicit bounded prior, run sensitivity/ablation, and replace legacy anchor shapes when stronger simulation or outcome evidence exists.
improve_now_with_existing_evidence.remaining_gap: Independent strategy-outcome target still required for empirical promotion.

improve_now_with_existing_evidence.action: Represent consolidation economics as an uncertainty set/distribution across supported curves rather than letting a single provisional curve carry hidden authority.
